season.window: Jun-Aug (early season best for the glacier)
season.evidence: Borealis Glacier logged ascents Jun 1, Jul 3; all-routes peak Jul 103, Jun 32, May 20; web: snow approach to Lucky Pass easiest early, late-summer glacier icy and broken (SummitPost, Mountaineers); stored Jun-Sep.

track.why: 23 May 2026 (about a week before the window opens): report describes Thunder Creek trailhead, crossing near McAllister Camp, Lucky Ridge boot trail, Borealis Glacier to the east ridge and summit, matching our East Slope text; track starts 48 m from our trailhead pin, returns to it and peaks at our summit. Only complete round trip on this route.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 20 Jun 2026 Borealis Glacier from Thunder Creek, an equally good match, but its start is 476 m from our trailhead pin so it fails the 300 m rule; no pin move proposed.
Inspiration Traverse from Thunder Creek ending at Eldorado, one-way and multi-peak.

facts.text: rope for the Borealis Glacier (mid-June snow was still roped); crampons optional in good snow
In mid-June the Borealis Glacier and the Lucky Pass snow were soft and continuous enough that crampons stayed in the pack.
In late May the whole route is under snow; ice axe and rope are needed for the glacier and the ridge above it.
Leave camp gear at Lucky Pass and go light for the final 1,500 ft to the summit.
In late May a camp on the Lucky Ridge crest near 5,300 ft worked well; logs jammed across the deep Thunder Creek channels helped the crossing, but these shift year to year.

season.evidence: No logged ascent names the North Ridge; stored Jul-Sep; web found no separate guidebook season; treated like the East Slope window.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Goes via Borealis Glacier to the east ridge, not the north ridge.

season.evidence: All-routes peak Jul 103; the Eldorado/Inspiration side is a July-through-September glacier objective per Mountaineers and trip pages; stored Jun-Aug.

track.why: 5 Jul 2024 logged South Slopes from the Eldorado trailhead; report crosses the Klawatti-Austera col and North Klawatti Glacier and climbs the south slopes, matching our Eldorado-side route above the McAllister Glacier; track starts and ends 20 m and 13 m from our trailhead pin and reaches the summit.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 4 Jul 2026 complete Eldorado round trip but no route name or report.
July 2014 Eldorado round trip logged SW face; line not clearly the same.
One-way, ends at the trailhead but starts at camp.

facts.text: Early July: pre-dawn snow was breakable crust and only firmed on the Klawatti Glacier until the sun hit.
At the Klawatti-Austera col a rappel station of three pitons exists; an exposed class 4 to low 5th move onto the col snow on its northeast side avoids the chimney.
Running water crosses the rocks near 7,035 ft just after rounding the east ridge of Austera, and again on the lower slopes of Primus.
In early July the North Klawatti crossing showed only small cracks needing no detour; the south slopes were a slog of snow-to-rock transitions with the final ~100 ft on class 1-2 rock.

notes: Two Peakbagger tracks from Thunder Creek start 476-677 m from our pin (3237284, 2752930); likely a different parking spot than the campground pin, not confirmed, so no move proposed.
